description: HTML (HyperText Markup Language) is the standard language for creating and structuring web pages.
CSS (Cascading Style Sheets) is used for styling and designing the layout of web pages.
JavaScript is a programming language that adds interactivity, dynamic content, and logic to web pages.
Accessibility ensures web content is usable by people with diverse abilities, including those with disabilities.
Responsive Web Design makes websites look good on all devices by adapting layouts to different screen sizes.
UI/UX focuses on creating visually appealing designs (UI) and enhancing user satisfaction through usability (UX).
React is a JavaScript library for building user interfaces, especially for single-page applications.
React Native is a framework for building native mobile apps using React and JavaScript.
Bootstrap is a popular front-end framework for building responsive and mobile-first websites quickly.
Other miscellaneous topics related to frontend development and tools.
